name: v5
instructions: A customer of a digital bank sent this message to support chat. Which topic best describes what the customer needs? Pick the single most specific topic.

criteria.identity_documents: Asks what documents or details are needed to verify their identity, or how to verify it
criteria.why_verify_identity: Asks why the bank needs to verify their identity
criteria.identity_verification_failing: Says identity verification is not working or they cannot complete it
criteria.source_of_funds: About verifying or proving the source of their money
criteria.edit_personal_details: Wants to change personal details such as name, address or phone number
criteria.close_account: Wants to close or delete their account
criteria.age_limit: Asks about minimum age to open or use an account
criteria.country_support: Asks which countries the bank serves or where the account can be used
criteria.passcode_forgotten: Forgot or needs to reset the app passcode, or cannot log into the app
criteria.unrecognised_card_payment: Sees a payment or debit to a merchant or name they do not recognise, a purchase they never made, or a seller taking money they did not approve
criteria.unrecognised_cash_withdrawal: Sees a cash withdrawal they did not make
criteria.unrecognised_direct_debit: Sees a direct debit they did not set up
criteria.compromised_card: Thinks their card or account has been compromised or used by someone else
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: Card is lost, missing or stolen and they want to report or block it
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: Their phone is lost or stolen
criteria.unknown_money_in_account: Money appeared in their account that they did not put there
criteria.request_refund: Wants their money back for a purchase or item, or asks about refund policy or process
criteria.refund_not_showing: A refund they expected has not appeared
criteria.item_not_received: Ordered goods have not arrived and they want their money back
criteria.dispute_payment: Wants to dispute a charge or payment
criteria.charged_twice: A single purchase or transaction was charged more than once
criteria.wrong_cash_amount: The ATM gave them a different, smaller amount of cash than they asked for, or they say they were not given the cash they withdrew
criteria.card_delivery: When their new card will arrive, delivery time, tracking, or card has not arrived
criteria.activate_card: How to activate a new card
criteria.link_card: Adding or linking a card in the app, or reactivating a card they found after reporting it lost
criteria.card_swallowed: An ATM kept or took their card
criteria.card_expiring: Their card is expiring or expired and needs renewal
criteria.spare_card: Wants an additional or second card
criteria.virtual_card: How to get a virtual card
criteria.disposable_card: About disposable or single-use virtual cards and their limits
criteria.virtual_card_not_working: Virtual card is not working or was rejected
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: Any question about Visa versus Mastercard: which one the bank issues, whether they can get or use either, or asking for one instead of the other
criteria.physical_card: Ordering or getting a physical card, or its cost
criteria.pin: Getting, finding, setting or changing their card PIN
criteria.pin_blocked: Their PIN is blocked, rejected or no longer gives access to the card, e.g. after too many wrong attempts
criteria.card_acceptance: Where the card is accepted or which ATMs can be used
criteria.card_declined: Their card stopped working or card payments are declined
criteria.declined_cash_withdrawal: The ATM refused or could not complete their cash withdrawal, so they could not get money out
criteria.card_limits: Spending or withdrawal limits on their card (not about fees)
criteria.transfer_pending: A bank transfer is pending or how long transfers take
criteria.transfer_not_received: A transfer they sent has not reached the recipient
criteria.transfer_failed: A transfer failed or was declined
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: Cannot send to a particular beneficiary or account
criteria.cancel_transfer: Wants to cancel, stop or revert a transfer or transaction they sent themselves, or fix one sent to the wrong account
criteria.cancel_purchase: Wants to cancel a purchase or an order placed with a merchant
criteria.transfer_methods: How to send a transfer, including whether a credit card or other card can be used to send or transfer money
criteria.crypto: Buying cryptocurrency or sending money to a cryptocurrency exchange, or such an activity not going through
criteria.receive_money: How to receive money or transfer money into their account, or get their salary paid in
criteria.balance_not_updated_transfer: Balance not updated after a bank transfer into the account
criteria.balance_not_updated_deposit: Balance not updated after depositing cash or a cheque
criteria.pending_card_payment: A card payment is pending or has not gone through
criteria.reverted_card_payment: A card payment was cancelled or reverted
criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal still shows as pending or processing in the app, or is not yet showing, including when the ATM failed and the transaction is stuck processing
criteria.top_up_failed: A top-up failed or was declined
criteria.top_up_pending: A top-up is pending or has not arrived
criteria.top_up_reverted: A top-up was reverted, returned or cancelled
criteria.top_up_verification: About a verification code or check for a top-up
criteria.top_up_methods: How to top up or add money, by card, bank transfer, cash or cheque (not via Apple Pay or Google Pay)
criteria.mobile_wallet: Anything involving Apple Pay, Google Pay or another phone or watch wallet, including adding money through them or them not working, even if the message also mentions a top-up or another card
criteria.supported_cards_currencies: Whether the bank accepts or supports a kind of card (such as a credit card or American Express) or a currency, for topping up or for use with the account (not about sending a transfer)
criteria.exchange_rate: How exchange rates are determined or what rate they will get
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate: They received a wrong exchange rate on a payment or cash withdrawal
criteria.exchange_in_app: How to exchange currencies in the app, or which currencies the bank lets them keep and convert
criteria.atm_fee: Fees for cash withdrawals at an ATM, including how much can be withdrawn without a fee
criteria.card_payment_fee: A fee charged for paying with a card
criteria.transfer_fee: A fee charged for a transfer
criteria.extra_charge_statement: An unexplained extra fee or small charge (such as a single pound or dollar) on their statement that they want explained or think is wrong
criteria.card_fees: What it costs to get, order, send or replace a card
